origin.description: The average of the observations, each raised to a chosen power.
origin.usage: moment(x, order = 1, central = FALSE, absolute = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector, matrix, or data frame. A matrix or data frame is one column at a time.

arguments.name: order
arguments.text: The power. Zero gives 1 for every value, including a missing value.

arguments.name: central
arguments.text: Subtract the mean before raising to order.

arguments.name: absolute
arguments.text: Take the absolute value after centering and before the power.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: Drop missing values first. In Python the argument is na_rm.

origin.details: The divisor is the length after the optional drop, not one less than that length. A matrix result keeps the column names. A negative value raised to a non-integer power is NaN.
origin.value: One number for a vector, or one number per column.
